name: AddNewWorksheet
description: Adds a new worksheet to a specified Excel file stored in OneDrive or SharePoint using the Microsoft 365 Excel API. Provide valid M365 credentials, the target Excel file's Drive and Item ID, and the name for the new worksheet. The connector will return the details of the newly added worksheet, along with the status code and message from the API.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Excel Credential
fields.description: The M365 Excel credential containing valid tenant ID, client ID, and client secret which is used to authenticate API requests.

fields.name: DriveAndItemId
fields.label: Drive and Item ID
fields.description: The Drive ID and Item ID of the Excel file in OneDrive or SharePoint (format: driveId/items/itemId).

fields.name: NewWorksheetName
fields.label: New Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the new worksheet to be added to the Excel file.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the details of the newly added worksheet.
